component.name: com.hyland.openarch.async.tasks.AsyncTasksService
component.documentation:
The Bulk Action Service allows to execute a Bulk Action Command. This consists of two steps:
Creation of a document set by scrolling the database
Execution of a bulk on document set

extension-point.name: asyncTasks
extension-point.documentation:
Allows to define the asynchronous tasks.
The bucket size determines the number of document ids per record at the scroller level, default is 100.
The batch size determines the number of document ids handled per transactions at the action level, default is 25.
